title: Puffing the cheeks: Mutt Carey, Dizzy Gillespie and Louis
summary: Punch says Carey and Gillespie puffed most, Louis some, Petit little, and that he tries to hold in.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone

blocks.x: Staccato style. Yeah, yeah. More stasplato. Yeah, stasplato, yeah. Do you notice many guys puffing their cheeks out in those days when they played?

Well, I puffed not myself, but the biggest puff I've ever seen is Mutt Carey and this boy that called Dizzy Gillespie. Dizzy Gillespie would go like that. Mutt Carey couldn't butt in the shite chair. He couldn't butt in there. He'd bust all that.
I noticed Frankie Asunto puffs a lot. Yeah. Yeah.
I do a little puffing now myself, but I used to do it. Probably if you wake a long time behind them trumpets, you're going to puff out some, you know, come grass with it.
Lee? Louie. Oh Lord, yeah Louie puffed man.
Yeah Louie puffed, but not much of these two frogs I'm talking about.
He looks like a frog. He looks all out in here, see. Oh, and his neck. Yeah, and his neck.

Buddy Petit didn't puff much. He didn't puff much. And Mutt didn't puff at all. Didn't puff at all. Just look just like he's sitting there now. That's why he's, and boy you couldn't see nothing. Just make any high in the world.
Well, you know I've always been conscious of the puffing. And I made an extra attempt to hold in.

Uh huh. And I've been in this for the last ten years. Well, I mean like that you can hold in. I've always been able to hold in. Yeah. If you got it in your mind about it. But the way we used to play, sometimes I'd be playing to think about it and I'd hold myself, but I'd get about half hard and I'd get to blowing it and forget all about that. Shucks. Yeah, you forget all about that.
